Nina: Nightly link-scan popped a few items under /kb/platform/deploy.md: two broken anchors and an external gist 404. Anyone on duty?
link-scan-bot: findings -> deploy.md#gpu-tiling (line 120), deploy.md#fallback-policy (line 198); gist 404 -> https://gist.github.com/old/deploy-snippet. Re-run scheduled.
Omar: I can patch anchors. will normalize to kebab-case anchors and add explicit HTML anchors to be safe.
Riley: I can rehost the gist. prefer /static/gists/deploy-snippets.md. Will also replace curl example to use stable token example.
Nina: Good. For redirects, let's use redirect_from in frontmatter so shortlinks keep working. Also add a tiny changelog note.
Omar: Quick command i'll run to find anchors: ```rg "href=.*#" docs/kb/platform/deploy.md -n```
Riley: Branches: fix/docs/deploy-anchors-600 and fix/docs/deploy-gist-600. I'll open PRs shortly.
doc-maintainer-bot: Please reference Linear ticket KB-820 in PR description.
Riley: PR #1402 opened for gist rehost -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1402
Omar: PR #1403 opened for anchors + frontmatter redirect + snapshot test -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1403
Nina: Jamie, can you review rendering after standup? We added raw HTML anchors so snapshot test is necessary.
Jamie: On it after standup. small ask: include rendered snippet screenshot in PR description to speed CI sanity checks.
Nina: Thanks team. doc-maintainer-bot will re-run scan; I'll mark KB-820 resolved once both PRs merge. Ping here when merged. :white_check_mark:
